name: Jubilee Storehouse - Aberystwyth Foodbank
short_description: Trussell Trust foodbank serving Borth and North Ceredigion
description: Jubilee Storehouse is the food bank for Aberystwyth and North Ceredigion. Serves Borth residents. Open Tue-Fri 10:00-14:00. Referral available via local agencies or self-referral at 0800 242 5844.

name: Borth Community Gardens and Allotments
short_description: Community gardens with allotments and orchard
description: Borth Community Gardens situated between St Matthews Church and Ynys Fergi Farm. Offers allotment plots for local residents and includes a community orchard. Plots available for rent.
